content.title: About Arvada
content.summary: Arvada has a population of 120,492 residents and encompasses 39.52 square miles, with 45,246 households. The city features over 150 miles of off-street bicycle and pedestrian trails, 4,200 acres of parks and open space, and 96% of residents live within half a mile of a park. Arvada operates under a Council/Manager form of government and is served by Jefferson County Public Schools.
